objective: Make the Android monthly calendar widget render from the in-app calendar contract: matching semantic colors, typography, marker treatment, holiday placement, and continuous-event row placement.
requirements: The in-app calendar tab is the styling source of truth for the home-screen monthly widget.
Monthly normal events remain 8.3sp and monthly holiday labels remain normal-event size plus 0.5sp (8.8sp) in both renderers.
Holiday-first placement and continuous spans crossing holidays must retain the same event row in the widget as in the app calendar.
Do not deploy, commit, or alter schedule data as part of this parity task.

included: Shared Flutter-to-Android style and month-cell payload contract
Continuous-event rows that cross holiday cells
excluded_pending_explicit_scope: Group calendar widget visual parity; it uses a separate provider/layout and was not demonstrated in the supplied screenshots

roles.assignment: Trace app-calendar and Android monthly-widget style, ordering, and row-placement paths.
Define a shared calendar style/payload contract and parity verification gates.
Implement style contract transfer, native widget rendering, and holiday-crossing continuous-event row preservation.
roles.result: Completed the shared contract and rework: normal 8.3sp / monthly holiday 8.8sp; semantic comparator parity; dynamic month row count; generation markers for incomplete payloads; API-first structured holiday {name,isDayOff} fallback; and leadingEventRowCount for a Chuseok-crossing span. API values override native fallback values when present.

roles.assignment: Run focused Flutter tests, analysis, Android Kotlin compilation, and diff check after rework.

evidence.result: No whitespace errors; CRLF warnings only

roles.assignment: Independently validate final app/widget parity and rework evidence.

Semantic ordering, holiday precedence, generation safeguards, dynamic row count, multi-day alignment, typography contract, duplicate-holiday filtering, and personal monthly widget scope are consistent.
final_review_report.retest_scope: Connected-device app/personal monthly widget screenshot is recommended before release; no code-level blocker remains.
